before-an-audit.html.lead: This page gives advice to a team whose product will be audited.

topics.title: Advice, not a rule
text: Nothing on this page is a rule of the check, except the habits with the status Checked. The rest is for your team to do.

topics.title: Names of tools
text: A tool is named as an example of a kind. Ordinance DS has not tested it, and does not recommend one tool over another.
